body:
Maintenance item gr-mt-orbit-dep-4: Upgrade TanStack Start dependencies to fix reflected XSS

Sources: https://github.com/just-every/run-orbit/security/dependabot/17, https://github.com/just-every/run-orbit/security/dependabot/16, https://github.com/just-every/run-orbit/security/dependabot/15

Bumped @tanstack/react-start 1.168.50 -> 1.168.60 (GHSA-qx66-fv34-fjm8); lockfile regenerated with pnpm 10.12.4 so transitive @tanstack/start-server-core resolves 1.169.32 -> 1.169.39. Also bumped direct @tanstack/react-router 1.170.33 -> 1.170.41, because leaving it duplicated the router and broke SSR (router.serverSsr.takeBufferedScripts is not a function, /app 500).

Tests: Node 22.20.0, pnpm 10.12.4: pnpm install --no-frozen-lockfile ok; pnpm run typecheck ok; pnpm run build:app ok; check:boundaries ok; deployment:check ok; test:worker (emitted Worker SSR, sessions, browser nav, assets) passed after router bump (failed 500 with the router left at 1.170.33). Full verify left to CI.
head: maint/gr-mt-orbit-dep-4
title: Upgrade TanStack Start dependencies to fix reflected XSS
